_doc: Sensitive-data keywords scanned by S12 (sensitive-data probing). When a routine-maintenance ticket's session contains commands that touch any of these tokens, S12 fires. The lists are deliberately short and obvious so the rule is auditable.
sensitive_command_examples: SELECT ssn, dob, salary FROM employees;
SELECT id, name, email, dob, ssn FROM customers WHERE region='AU';
SELECT card_number, cvv FROM payment_methods LIMIT 1000;
